## Purpose

Consolidate eight small XPU enablement/backend-parity source patches into one review unit. Draft status is intentional: a human must confirm eligibility before enabling normal CI.

Run: **LIVE — 2026-10-19 (America/Vancouver)**. Base: `8e7601ae4a48c1127afd1bcdccf0a0ad61dbf043`. Candidate universe: all 118 SGLang PR entries in the runner’s authoritative 2026-10-19 XPU source report; no repository-wide open-PR scan. Authentication and both remotes verified. No current-week PR existed. Earlier consolidations #37193, #39439, #40664 and #42627 were audited for repeat sources.

## Included source PRs

All eight sources are open, non-draft, have no unresolved Changes Requested or content-change review threads, and retain a nonempty patch absent from main and earlier consolidations. Each net patch was replayed mechanically; substantive source fixes remain with authors.

Pinned wheel: `v0.4.0+xpu` from current `python/pyproject_xpu.toml`. Exact kernel source release **R = `028ac5a4e92a4addabeedac1a94374515f68e4a5` (`v0.4.0`)**. Each numbered dependency below was compared directly to R and has **zero commits behind**. API, assertions, dtype/layout behavior and focused tests were inspected at R; unspecified manual environments and green top-level CI were not used as release proof.
- [#32136](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32136) by @cyxlily, source head `5d3455e1261a6aeffcfb6f9c59768b9e564eb75a` — Focused XPU top-k transform coverage. Kernel #248 (`3cfe90204f9367820c7c2230dfae72194097fd76`) is an ancestor of release R. Inspected `python/sgl_kernel/top_k.py`, `src/sycl/TopKTransform.cpp`, operator registrations and `tests/test_topk_transform.py`: float32 scores, int32 lengths/tables/offsets, K=2048, PAGED/RAGGED transforms and -1 padding are supported. Test-only patch; formatting normalized by current Ruff.
- [#43208](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43208) by @desmond-intel, source head `be6dac5bb0669e4107db852555dd51c4446273da` — Small Transformers checkpoint-loader parity fix with regression coverage; patterns filter only unexpected keys and retain matching real parameters. Kernel-independent: regex/weight-loading logic only.
- [#43843](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43843) by @vshekhawat-hlab, source head `4fbfec6388b48dcb7a2558f6ac0b371bfec7dde5` — Small XPU guard leaves the existing embedding-mask helper eager. Kernel-independent: same Torch computation; adds no wheel API or layout requirement.
- [#43891](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43891) by @desmond-intel, source head `0b570c36458860c80b996090bbc7bb3554762aa8` — Removes duplicate model-side routed scaling on XPU. Kernel #38 (`eb1406936cd0492640ef663a4c0500c7316af4f4`), #161 (`762aed9b6563ae504997c74a991f09d9ecc62cd3`), #329 (`1a263584b91861b03b795ceca6eba25a762c6a44`) and #341 (`93ee9cc840e83e36af47791cd60869a30740061e`) are ancestors of release R. Inspected released `python/sgl_kernel/moe.py`, `src/sycl/MoEPrepareInputs.cpp` and `src/sycl/MoE_sum_reduce.cpp`: BF16/FP8/MXFP4 expert-combine and sum-reduce paths already apply routed scaling; current SGLang callers pass that factor.
- [#44561](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44561) by @hotschmoe, source head `e88a91355b20cab46b48d151c48c70b4e5f19eca` — Small CUDA-only import guard permits Qwen4Exp loading without CUDA communication dependencies. Kernel-independent: removes an inapplicable import; adds no XPU operator. Source Git author @hotschmoe is preserved; live GitHub metadata identifies @hotschmoe as the PR author (the report listed @desmond-intel).
- [#44670](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44670) by @desmond-intel, source head `6331e1bf8677276b65da8d45ca99c5a6910a8964` — Small correction packs valid image rows before existing varlen attention and restores zero padding. Kernel #23 (`7c98b0d8e01d0c656405980eb20f7935b7eaad24`) and #220 (`a8b1ec93f01201dbdd21be1318b06ae27f9b3163`) are ancestors of release R. Inspected released `python/sgl_kernel/flash_attn.py`, `src/sycl/flash_attention.cpp`, prefill dispatch and focused tests: BF16 ragged Q/K/V, int32 cumulative lengths and head_dim=72 are supported.
- [#44851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44851) by @alexnails, source head `c3453919feda25cdaea8659210006dbccaed7bca` — Narrow Gemma4 text-only enablement: omit unused encoders/weights, preserve the processor tokenizer, use existing language-model-only admission. Kernel-independent: no attention/MLP operator, signature, dtype or layout changes; the source’s original full-model fixture already uses the same intel_xpu backend/page-size settings. Includes its cookbook recipe and coverage; does not include frozen-KV parent-stack work.
- [#44863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44863) by @alexnails, source head `eccea92f45cbd292eb3300fb7a6f94c80ba0c4c4` — Small XPU platform/capability-detection parity fix with regression coverage. Kernel-independent: device inventory/selection metadata only. Its two-file net patch is independent of the declared serving stack; replay preserves main’s CUDA_ONLY constant.

## Commit policy

Exactly one source PR per commit, in ascending PR-number order. Preserve each source Git author identity/date, use a title ending in `(#PR_NUMBER)`, and include the source URL/head in its body. No source branches, comments, reviews or PRs were modified. Only this managed weekly branch is pushed to `airMeng`; nothing is merged.

Consolidate eight small XPU enablement/backend-parity source patches into one review unit. Draft status is intentional: a human must confirm eligibility before enabling normal CI.

Run: **LIVE — 2026-10-19 (America/Vancouver)**. Base: `8e7601ae4a48c1127afd1bcdccf0a0ad61dbf043`. Candidate universe: all 118 SGLang PR entries in the runner’s authoritative 2026-10-19 XPU source report; no repository-wide open-PR scan. Authentication and both remotes verified. No current-week PR existed. Earlier consolidations #37193, #39439, #40664 and #42627 were audited for repeat sources.

## Included source PRs

All eight sources are open, non-draft, have no unresolved Changes Requested or content-change review threads, and retain a nonempty patch absent from main and earlier consolidations. Each net patch was replayed mechanically; substantive source fixes remain with authors.

Pinned wheel: `v0.4.0+xpu` from current `python/pyproject_xpu.toml`. Exact kernel source release **R = `028ac5a4e92a4addabeedac1a94374515f68e4a5` (`v0.4.0`)**. Each numbered dependency below was compared directly to R and has **zero commits behind**. API, assertions, dtype/layout behavior and focused tests were inspected at R; unspecified manual environments and green top-level CI were not used as release proof.
- [#32136](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32136) by @cyxlily, source head `5d3455e1261a6aeffcfb6f9c59768b9e564eb75a` — Focused XPU top-k transform coverage. Kernel #248 (`3cfe90204f9367820c7c2230dfae72194097fd76`) is an ancestor of release R. Inspected `python/sgl_kernel/top_k.py`, `src/sycl/TopKTransform.cpp`, operator registrations and `tests/test_topk_transform.py`: float32 scores, int32 lengths/tables/offsets, K=2048, PAGED/RAGGED transforms and -1 padding are supported. Test-only patch; formatting normalized by current Ruff.
- [#43208](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43208) by @desmond-intel, source head `be6dac5bb0669e4107db852555dd51c4446273da` — Small Transformers checkpoint-loader parity fix with regression coverage; patterns filter only unexpected keys and retain matching real parameters. Kernel-independent: regex/weight-loading logic only.
- [#43843](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43843) by @vshekhawat-hlab, source head `4fbfec6388b48dcb7a2558f6ac0b371bfec7dde5` — Small XPU guard leaves the existing embedding-mask helper eager. Kernel-independent: same Torch computation; adds no wheel API or layout requirement.
- [#43891](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43891) by @desmond-intel, source head `0b570c36458860c80b996090bbc7bb3554762aa8` — Removes duplicate model-side routed scaling on XPU. Kernel #38 (`eb1406936cd0492640ef663a4c0500c7316af4f4`), #161 (`762aed9b6563ae504997c74a991f09d9ecc62cd3`), #329 (`1a263584b91861b03b795ceca6eba25a762c6a44`) and #341 (`93ee9cc840e83e36af47791cd60869a30740061e`) are ancestors of release R. Inspected released `python/sgl_kernel/moe.py`, `src/sycl/MoEPrepareInputs.cpp` and `src/sycl/MoE_sum_reduce.cpp`: BF16/FP8/MXFP4 expert-combine and sum-reduce paths already apply routed scaling; current SGLang callers pass that factor.
- [#44561](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44561) by @hotschmoe, source head `e88a91355b20cab46b48d151c48c70b4e5f19eca` — Small CUDA-only import guard permits Qwen4Exp loading without CUDA communication dependencies. Kernel-independent: removes an inapplicable import; adds no XPU operator. Source Git author @hotschmoe is preserved; live GitHub metadata identifies @hotschmoe as the PR author (the report listed @desmond-intel).
- [#44670](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44670) by @desmond-intel, source head `6331e1bf8677276b65da8d45ca99c5a6910a8964` — Small correction packs valid image rows before existing varlen attention and restores zero padding. Kernel #23 (`7c98b0d8e01d0c656405980eb20f7935b7eaad24`) and #220 (`a8b1ec93f01201dbdd21be1318b06ae27f9b3163`) are ancestors of release R. Inspected released `python/sgl_kernel/flash_attn.py`, `src/sycl/flash_attention.cpp`, prefill dispatch and focused tests: BF16 ragged Q/K/V, int32 cumulative lengths and head_dim=72 are supported.
- [#44851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44851) by @alexnails, source head `c3453919feda25cdaea8659210006dbccaed7bca` — Narrow Gemma4 text-only enablement: omit unused encoders/weights, preserve the processor tokenizer, use existing language-model-only admission. Kernel-independent: no attention/MLP operator, signature, dtype or layout changes; the source’s original full-model fixture already uses the same intel_xpu backend/page-size settings. Includes its cookbook recipe and coverage; does not include frozen-KV parent-stack work.
- [#44863](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44863) by @alexnails, source head `eccea92f45cbd292eb3300fb7a6f94c80ba0c4c4` — Small XPU platform/capability-detection parity fix with regression coverage. Kernel-independent: device inventory/selection metadata only. Its two-file net patch is independent of the declared serving stack; replay preserves main’s CUDA_ONLY constant.

## Commit policy

Exactly one source PR per commit, in ascending PR-number order. Preserve each source Git author identity/date, use a title ending in `(#PR_NUMBER)`, and include the source URL/head in its body. No source branches, comments, reviews or PRs were modified. Only this managed weekly branch is pushed to `airMeng`; nothing is merged.

The source’s dtype-only StableLM change cannot satisfy partial-RoPE dimensions on this base. It was removed before publication; no behavioral fix was invented.

## Validation

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- `pre-commit run --files <all 18 changed files>` — all applicable hooks passed, including registered-test validation. Only top-k test whitespace formatting was normalized, in its source commit.
- Python AST parsing — all 16 changed Python files passed.
- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/kernels/test_kernels_namespace.py` — 65 passed.
- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/kernels/test_fused_op.py` — 22 passed.
- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/kernels/test_fused_op_dispatch.py` — 35 passed.
- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_transformers_fallback.py` — 3 passed, including both source regressions.
- `python -m pytest -q test/registered/xpu/test_vision_backend_selection.py -k "backend_selection_priority and not None-None-xpu_attn"` — 3 explicit-routing cases passed; hardware-default and numerical cases deselected.
- Supplemental CPU production-function probes — 3 padded/packed vision cases passed using a mocked native kernel and CPU SDPA; 2 tokenizer-routing cases passed using mocked loaders. These do not validate the native XPU kernel or real model token IDs.
- The full vision selection attempt had one expected hardware-default failure on CPU (`sdpa` versus `xpu_attn`); the assertion requires XPU. A server-args `-k language_model_only` attempt selected no tests and is not counted as a pass. Missing environment packages encountered during setup were installed; the four CPU suites above subsequently passed.

Source-check classification: missing run-ci/run-ci-extra labels and stale-base maintenance gates were not content failures. #43208’s executed failures were HiCache host-memory/NPU allocation, AMD KDA/bit-exact kernels, diffusion timing and native-model PD tests outside this loader path. #44851/#44863’s coverage-service curl 403s and #44863’s AMD KDA/FlyDSL failures were unrelated to their net patches. #43891’s old title failure has a newer successful title check. Source lint is successful for all included heads. No failed job was rerun.

Not run: native XPU top-k/vision numerical tests; Gemma4 text/full-model server, real token-ID/media-rejection/graph tests; model accuracy/performance tests; CUDA/XPU end-to-end tests; Mintlify validate/broken-links (Node.js/Mint CLI unavailable). A human should review eligibility and run focused XPU tests with the exact pinned wheel before enabling normal CI.
